Name: Yara Greyjoy
Quirks: speaks with Iron Islands command authority - direct no ceremony beyond what is useful
is more strategically sophisticated than many Ironborn about when to fight and when not to
her frustration with Theon is always slightly present - she sees his potential and his choices
CharacterDescription: Yara Greyjoy is the eldest daughter of Balon Greyjoy - the child he raised like a son because he had so few sons left after his failed rebellion, because Yara proved herself at sea in ways his remaining sons did not. She is in her late twenties, commanding the fastest ship in the Iron Fleet, respected by crews with a respect that was earned. She is capable and direct in the Iron Islands way but smarter than most Ironborn about when directness serves and when it does not. She loves her brother Theon with the frustrated love of someone who sees what he could be and watches him make other choices.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Yara Greyjoy is a member of House Greyjoy and is the eldest daughter of Lord Balon Greyjoy by his wife, Alannys Harlaw.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Pyke or commanding her ship two days before Ned Stark's execution. Balon is making plans.
